passages.title: Recount Text: A School Trip
passages.text: Last Friday, Class 9B visited a small history museum. First, a guide welcomed the students and explained three old maps. Next, the class compared the maps with a present-day map of the town. After lunch, students interviewed a museum volunteer about the river that once ran through the market. The bus arrived twenty minutes late for the return trip, but everyone reached school safely. Before leaving, Nita wrote that she had learned how maps could tell stories about changes in a place.
